name: LIGHTS / LAMPS / SWITCHES
text:
Among the most configurable parts to an infrared sauna are the lights. Lighting is important to be configured to add to the sauna experience, through relaxation.
Lamps and illumination of the sauna area is important. Configuration of switches could also help you get more from your sauna.
Lights will help you see and feel better, a properly chosen lighting system could also make the sauna look pretty and luxurious.

If your infrared sauna lighting has stopped working of if there is an issue with it, it could also be wiring, you can use the troubleshooting contact form to receive a free consultation.

On our site you can find replacement parts or upgrades.

We’re looking forward to providing you with lighting to your taste.
text_short: Sauna lighting is an important detail, which provides the relaxing effect of the infrared sauna. It carries on the practical function and has significant aesthetic value. Lights can be used to create a peaceful atmosphere and to bring out some special details in the sauna.
